factual_claims.claim: Coop Pank reported weaker financial results for the 2025 financial year, primarily impacted by a lower-interest economic environment that offset strong business volume growth.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Managing Director´s Statement: 'The decline in net profit compared to the previous year was mainly caused by the lower-interest economic environment, which the 19% growth in business volumes could not offset.'

factual_claims.claim: Net profit for the period decreased by 11% to 28.7 million euros compared with 32.2 million euros in the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results table: Net profit 2025: 28.7 million euros, 2024: 32.2 million euros. Calculation: (32.2 - 28.7)/32.2 = ~11% decrease.

factual_claims.claim: Total net operating income also declined slightly by 3% to 79.4 million euros from 81.9 million euros, driven by a reduction in net interest income to 73.2 million euros from 77.5 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results table: Total net operating income 2025: 79.4 million euros, 2024: 81.9 million euros (~3% decrease). Net interest income 2025: 73.3 million euros, 2024: 77.6 million euros.

factual_claims.claim: Conversely, net fee and commission income rose to 4.5 million euros compared with 4.4 million euros, and net other income improved to 1.5 million euros from zero.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results table: Net fee and commission income 2025: 4.5 million euros, 2024: 4.3 million euros. Net other income 2025: 1.5 million euros, 2024: 0 million euros.

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses increased to 41.5 million euros from 40.6 million euros, contributing to a higher cost-to-income ratio of 52.3% compared with 49.6% in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results table: Operating expenses 2025: -41.5 million euros, 2024: -40.6 million euros. Cost to income ratio 2025: 52.3%, 2024: 49.6%.

factual_claims.claim: Credit loss allowances improved, decreasing to 3.3 million euros from 4.6 million euros, while income tax expense increased to 5.8 million euros from 4.5 million euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Financial results table: Credit loss allowance 2025: -3.3 million euros, 2024: -4.6 million euros. Income tax expense 2025: -5.8 million euros, 2024: -4.5 million euros.

factual_claims.claim: Return on equity stood at 12.9% compared with 16.2% in the prior year, and return on assets was 1.2% compared with 1.6%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Ratios table: Return on equity (ROE) 2025: 12.9%, 2024: 16.2%. Return on assets (ROA) 2025: 1.2%, 2024: 1.6%.

numerical_claims.claim: In the first quarter of 2025, Coop Pank issued its inaugural covered bonds on the Irish stock exchange amounting to 250 million euros with a four-year maturity under a newly established 750 million euro program, providing a stable long-term funding source that allowed the bank to intentionally reduce more expensive term deposits.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Managing Director´s Statement: 'In the first quarter of 2025, Coop Pank issued covered bonds on the Irish stock exchange for the first time, amounting to €250 million with a four-year maturity.'

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Managing Director´s Statement: 'This was the first tranche of a €750 million covered bond program.'

numerical_claims.claim: Additionally, towards the end of the year, the bank entered into a synthetic securitization guarantee agreement with the European Investment Bank Group to optimize regulatory capital and enable up to 249 million euros in new loans for sustainable and gender-equality projects in Estonia.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Managing Director´s Statement: 'This stable long-term funding allowed the bank to begin intentionally reducing the volume of more expensive term and foreign deposits... The new funding will be directed toward projects in Estonia that promote gender equality and environmental sustainability... This is Coop Pank’s first synthetic securitization transaction... enabling the provision of up to €249 million in new loans.'

numerical_claims.claim: The bank also secured a 5 million euro subordinated loan from the European Energy Efficiency Fund.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Managing Director´s Statement: 'Additionally, Coop Pank signed a loan agreement at the end of the year with the European Energy Efficiency Fund (EEEF), under which the bank will take an unsecured subordinated loan of €5 million... per annum.'
